_doc: Hand-maintained corrections for .github/scripts/gen_data_connectors.py (see its docstring). Per connector: category / region / title / desc / name, key_required (true ONLY when the connector cannot return data without its key — decided by reading the script and checked with a keyless smoke run), key_note, docs_url, default_command / default_args, args_hints, commands / commands_add / commands_drop, ttl_sec, mcp (false = a dedicated MCP tool already covers it) and broken (why the upstream does not work; the connector stays browsable in the UI but gets no MCP tool). Regenerate after editing: python .github/scripts/gen_data_connectors.py

exclude.akshare_data.py: Served by the AkShare screen; endpoints resolve dynamically (getattr), not a fixed command list.
exclude.screener_data.py: Backs the Equity Screener (services/screener/ScreenerService); takes JSON criteria on stdin, not a generic `<command> [args]` connector.
